regions.today: Today will be sunny and warm in a light to moderate northerly breeze. Highest temperatures from 22 degrees in the north of the region to 26 degrees further south.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry and clear with isolated mist patches possible. Fresher than recent nights with lowest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees in a light northerly or variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be another dry and warm day with hazy sunshine. Highest temperatures of 23 to 26 degrees in a light northerly breeze.
